en.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
en.hook: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves, sparking debate over wildlife conservation
key_takeaways: Trump signed an executive order to remove gray wolves from the Endangered Species Act
The move could impact wolf populations and ecosystem balance
Environmentalists and scientists criticize the decision

zh.title: 特朗普签署命令取消灰狼濒危物种保护
zh.hook: 特朗普签署命令取消灰狼濒危物种保护，引发关于野生动物保护的争论
key_takeaways: 特朗普签署行政命令，将灰狼从濒危物种名录中移除

环保人士和科学家批评这一决定
